name: AVA (Atomic Visual Actions)
description: Spatiotemporally localized, densely-labeled human actions in movie clips, with multiple action labels for people. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Gu, C., Sun, C., Ross, D. A., et al. (2018). AVA: A Video Dataset of Spatio-temporally Localized Atomic Visual Actions. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 6047–6056. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2018.00633

license.identifier: Custom AVA dataset terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: AVA is provided under dataset-specific terms rather than a standard SPDX license. Review the upstream terms and the rights associated with source video content before use or redistribution.
